title: Import/Link Framework & Initial Provider Adapters

future_start_resolution: freshly verify then-current AIOC and application heads and re-read completed AAI-01..05 evidence
define provider-neutral import-versus-link semantics without treating possession or a provider reference as expanded rights
select the initial provider-adapter set only from current verified AAI-01 rights/terms and AAI-03 capability evidence; no provider is presumed authorized or complete
resolve per-provider authentication, entitlement, catalog, playback/control, local-file and manual-reference boundaries before any live call; keep credentials secret and out of receipts/source
keep acquisition, download, cache, transform, export, recording, streaming and redistribution independently rights-gated and fail closed
preserve AAI-05 semantic selection as provider-neutral input; adapters cannot alter semantic ranking, grant rights or create gameplay truth
re-check current provider terms and operational evidence for Syrinscape, TableTone and other chosen providers; absence of a public API or written expanded permission remains nonauthorization
determine whether durable persistence is required and reserve migration 0022 only for a separately demonstrated canonical schema delta
resolve exact deliverables, provider-safe test doubles/fixtures, focused verifier/tests, predecessor regressions and exact-head self-hosted acceptance gate before creating an implementation branch
selection_contract.authority_rule: Selection authorizes planning resolution only. It does not authorize an implementation branch, provider authentication, live catalog/provider calls, content acquisition/download/copying/caching, scraping/reverse engineering, payment, migration 0022, tester distribution, release or deployment.
selection_contract.provider_rule: Commercial/provider-controlled audio remains controlled or referenced unless current verified rights explicitly allow another operation. Unsupported, undocumented, provider-contact-required, denied or unknown evidence remains fail closed.
selection_contract.owner_rule: Import/link/adapter state remains audio presentation/support data only and cannot create or replace canonical gameplay truth.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..05 are completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-06 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or implementation authority
AAI-02 rights/provenance, AAI-03 capability, AAI-05 semantic compatibility and runtime availability remain independent
no provider/catalog is canonical and unsupported/unknown evidence remains fail closed
commercial provider audio is controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit current license/authority
Syrinscape/TableTone/other provider-specific live behavior requires a fresh rights/terms/capability check before governed start
unsupported operations cannot be emulated by scraping, reverse engineering or prohibited copying
migration 0022 remains unreserved until a separately demonstrated durable schema delta requires it
no provider authentication/live catalog/provider calls/acquisition/download/copying/caching/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation is authorized by selection
next_action: Selection only. On the next owner Continue, freshly verify then-current AIOC/application heads, re-read AAI-01..05 completed evidence plus the AAI program/backlog and this selection contract, resolve the exact provider-safe import/link and initial-adapter, rights/capability/credential/persistence/validation contract, and only then governed-start AAI-06.
